# EnterpriseGlue v0.28.9 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.28.8`.

## Highlights

- **saas-authentication:** Lets pooled SaaS users sign in with a global Cloud identity provider and enter an organization only after authenticated membership checks.

## User and administrator impact

- The neutral organization finder offers configured Cloud account sign-in methods alongside email and organization-name discovery, with a separate account-creation link; existing personal-email accounts can use the one-time email-link fallback.
- After Cloud sign-in, one active organization opens automatically; multiple active memberships require an explicit organization choice on the same login page, using the same option layout as sign-in.

## API and integration compatibility

- The global Cloud identity-provider start endpoint accepts the exact /login return path in addition to /cloud/onboarding.

## Configuration

- Cloud account identity remains opt-in; tenant-specific login policies and DNS-verified discovery domains are unchanged.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- The provider callback return path remains exact and signed; organization entry rechecks an authenticated active membership and issues a tenant-bound session.
- No account or tenant is selected from an unverified email alone, and email-only account merging remains disabled.

## Documentation

- The technical SSO guide describes identity-first Cloud account sign-in and authenticated organization selection.

## Published packages

| Package | Previous | New | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `@enterpriseglue/backend-host` | `0.19.10` | `0.19.11` | patch |
| `@enterpriseglue/frontend-host` | `0.17.20` | `0.17.21` | patch |
| `@enterpriseglue/shared` | `0.22.6` | `0.22.7` | patch |

## Known limitations

- A work-email domain shared by multiple organizations cannot automatically identify one tenant before authentication.

## Rollback

- Redeploy the prior OSS host images; existing tenant discovery and Cloud onboarding sign-in remain available and no database rollback is needed.

## Validation evidence

- Frontend and browser tests cover global provider presentation, sole-tenant entry, multiple-membership selection, and failure handling.
- PostgreSQL identity integration verifies the signed /login callback, membership-gated tenant switch, and sibling denial.
